title: Student Placement Prediction
description: Campus placement outcomes depend on a mix of academic performance, work experience, and specialisation choices. This project builds an end-to-end machine learning pipeline — from raw data to a deployed, interactive web app — to predict whether a student is likely to be placed, and to explain why the model made that prediction for a given student.

title: nextstep
description:
NextStep is a smart career guidance platform designed to help students and young professionals plan their career journey. It offers features like Career Path Finder, Skill Gap Analyzer, Roadmap Generator, Portfolio Builder, and Resume Analyzer.
The platform helps users understand which career suits them, what skills they need to develop, and the step-by-step actions they can take to achieve their career goals—making career planning simpler, more personalised, and accessible.
